rca of the issue: PREVIOUSLY (iter38): SW aggressively cached opaque map tile responses; Chromium pads each opaque cache entry by ~7MB, exhausting the 1GB origin quota after just login + one navigation. That in turn made ALL IndexedDB readwrite transactions abort with QuotaExceededError, so offline photo capture could not queue. FIX APPLIED (verified in this iter39): (a) TileLayer sets crossOrigin='anonymous' so tiles arrive as CORS responses (no padding); (b) service-worker.js v4 skips caching any response with type==='opaque'; (c) trimCache enforces MAX ENTRIES per cache (tiles 2500 / api 300 / static 120) with LRU-style eviction on every 50th put; (d) old cache names are deleted on SW activate; (e) offlineTiles prefetch uses mode:'cors'. Measured post-fix: 7.09MB used / 870MB quota after login + pole edit form + reload. Offline photo E2E now works end-to-end: photoQueue write succeeds, syncQueue update:pole write succeeds, syncOfflinePhotos uploads to /upload-photo and PUTs /poles/{id} with the real URL. Backend GET confirms birthmark_photos contains only a real /api/files/poledata/uploads/... URL after reconnect.
